packageRules.description: AWS Emulator: security fixes ship only in the latest release, so a new version merges itself once the required checks pass. A person is needed only when a release changes a result
prBodyNotes:
The `emulator gaps` check on this pull request says which of the emulator's gaps are still there (`task emulator:gaps`). A gap that has closed does not block the merge: an issue is raised for it once this is on `main`.

**When this merges, or if a check fails:**
- [ ] `task skills:update` so the `aws-emulator` skill is current
- [ ] A new difference from AWS is added to `tools/emulator/gaps/` and reported at https://github.com/aws/aws-emulator/issues if it is not already there

packageRules.description: Skill sources move often and each update needs task skills:fetch run on its branch; once a week is enough

A release is proposed once it is three days old: a compromised package is usually found and withdrawn within that. Only where the registry says when a release was made; the emulator and the skill sources are not held back
One pull request for routine npm updates
